title.en: Ask the sensor ladder which rung a device can satisfy for simmering, sauteing and deep frying

goal.en: Each operation envelope lists ways to verify the step, best first. The ladder tool returns the first rung a device can satisfy, or null when the step must be refused.

note.en: Simmering with a liquid thermometer: the sensor is the first rung.
No thermometer, estimates allowed: a logged model estimate.
No thermometer, no estimates: simmering may run on time alone, because it is unattended-safe.
Sauteing with nothing and nobody: null. Its last rung is a person watching.
The same with a person present: the human rung.
Deep frying with a person present but no oil thermometer: still null. The ladder has one rung.

cli: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:7878/v1/tools/ladder -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"op": "cw.op.simmer", "sensors": ["cw.sense.liquid_temp"], "allowModel": true, "humanPresent": false}'
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:7878/v1/tools/ladder -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"op": "cw.op.saute", "sensors": [], "allowModel": false, "humanPresent": false}'
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:7878/v1/tools/ladder -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"op": "cw.op.deep_fry", "sensors": [], "allowModel": true, "humanPresent": true}'

outcome.en: You can predict, per operation, which sensors a device needs so that a plan does not fall back to a person. Next: scenario 026 walks the boiling ladder rung by rung.
